provider_metadata.address: 2, NK Guesthouse, 73/12 Soi Sukhumvit 4, Khlong Teoy, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10110, Thailand

rental_conditions.requirements: Must have a valid passport and driving license of which we will keep a copy
rental_conditions.cash_deposit: Deposit for all rentals is to be paid before receiving the bike and will be returned accordingly after inspection of the bikes returned condition. Note: Failure to return the bike to the shop at the end of your rental or failure to properly schedule a pickup with us will result in a loss of deposit.
rental_conditions.payments: Payments can be made on a weekly, monthly, or yearly basis. Simply deposit the money into our account bank from cash deposit machine and send us a notification/pic of the receipt or made cash payment at NK Guesthouse 2 (Reception Counter).
rental_conditions.reservations: All customers are allowed to extend their rentals as long as they would like, or return as needed. (Within working hours) For that reason availability is not known in advance so we currently do not offer reservations or bookings early. We recommend contacting us upon arrival or a day before so we can give you an updated list of available bikes.
rental_conditions.driving_license: Driving license in Thailand are required by law, though rarely checked and generally any ID or passport will suffice. However the actual law is a bit of a confused issue with even Thai police officers rarely knowing the correct law. Most countries license which includes an English translation on it, or an International Drivers Permit are approved by Thailand for use while on a Tourist visa. If staying for over 6 months or on a non-tourist visa a Thai license is required.

rental_inclusions: two standard half-style uni-size helmets free of charge
Rental helmets are used for a maximum of one year before being replaced

motorcycle_offerings.description: Honda PCX 150 is an expected model that carries a 153cc, liquid cooled and fuel injected engine, producing 13.4 BHP and 14 Nm of torque. It comes mated to an automatic gearbox and uses 220 mm front disc brake for efficient braking. It uses telescopic forks at the front and weighs 130 kg with a full fuel tank. In India, the engine may loose the fuel injection and liquid cooling feature while they may even use the engine from Unicorn 150 for the scooter. This will even keep the costs low for the scooter. It will rival Aprilia SR150 and Vespa VXL 150 in the country.

Experience premium design and comfort in your daily ride. Pure performance and outstanding fuel economy is made possible with a 155cc Liquid Cooled Blue Core engine, VVA Technology, and ABS System. The Yamaha NMax is the sporty urban commuter just for you!

Its power ran backed by a new generation 155cc engine equipped with "Variable Valve Actuation" (VVA) to make the engine pull performance more powerful. Equipped with "Forged Piston & DiAsil Cylinder" is strong and lightweight so that maximum engine performance, and also equipped with "Smart Motor Generator" (SMG) which makes the motor sound smoother when turned on.  
  
Supported with a gold rear suspension type Sub-Tanks, providing a more stable driving experience, the 230mm Wave-Type Disc Brake will provide a maximum driving experience. Beneath the seating area is spacious and can hold full-face helmets and other driving gear. Front and rear LED lights with sporty design, brighter and more durable. Supported with a full digital speedometer that is modern and informative for the rider.

The New CLICK150i is powered by a 150cc, Liquid-cooled, PGM-FI engine with Enhanced Smart Power and an ACG Starter and Idling Stop System, which gives the bike a fuel economy of 52km/L.  
The CLICK150i also equipped with a full digital meter panel and an all LED Lighting. Meanwhile, it exclusively comes with a 3D emblem proudly signifying its name.  
For more convenience and added security, the model also brims with advanced features namely the Smart Key System with keyless, ignition on/off, Anti-Theft Alarm, and an Answer Back System. It also comes with new sporty wheel design with wider tubeless tires, wavy disc brake and a sporty alluminum pillion steps.

Yamaha Filano 125 Hybrid is a new, hybrid model of regular Yamaha Filano 125. It is a new retro scooter with a sophisticated design. Comfortable scooter for the everyday city and beach rides. Lightweight, maneuverable, and easy to operate. Due to the small size, it is doing well in traffic. Yamaha Grand Filano Hybrid runs on a CVT transmission that's aided with a start-stop engine, courtesy of the brand's Blue Core Efficiency engine design approach. As such, would-be Grand Filano Hybrid users are given the option to leave the start-stop engine on or off whenever it becomes feasible. This motorbike is equipped with a keyless start, a USB charging port, and full LED lighting on both front and rear, a 27-liter storage compartment that's situated right beneath the lift-up set. Yamaha Filano is a legitimate rival of Honda PCX Hybrid.

The New CLICK125i is powered by a 125cc Liquid-cooled, PGM-FI engine with Enhanced Smart Power and an ACG starter, making the model fuel efficient at 53 km/L. The model comes with the Combi Brake System and Park Brake Lock for added safety features.  
Topping it off is the advanced full digital meter panel which provides real-time fuel consumption, battery and change oil indicator, trip meter, and digital clock.

The Honda Scoopy model is a Scooter bike manufactured by Honda . In this version sold from year 2013 , the dry weight is 91.0 kg (200.6 pounds) and it is equipped with a Single cylinder, four-stroke motor.
The Fino 125 is a 2 Seater Scooter and has a length of 1870 mm the width of 700 mm, and a wheelbase of 1260 mm. along with a ground clearance of 135 mm.

QBIX 125 is the ultimate step by the Japanese bike manufacturer to the future world. QBIX is an automated scooter with innovative and futuristic technology. From the first stance, it resembles something of a science fiction movie or something related to robots. The engineers had cleverly carved each and every section of this scooter in a slightly different way by keeping all the feel and outlook of the real day scooter. The scooter gets some of the advanced features such as LED headlamp and taillight, LCD instrument display, 22.5-litre under seat storage space, big 12-inch rear tyre, and mobile charging socket.

Honda Scoopy is yet another unique product from the Japanese manufacturer. It seems like they are focusing on scooter segment as this will take total number of gearless machines to eight. Honda will use the same 109.19cc, single cylinder engine from all other scooters on the Scoopy, helping them keep cost under check and improving overall localization for this product. The engine is good for 8 BHP and 9 Nm of torque. It weighs surprisingly less at 99 kg and thus, could be the best performing scooter with its premium features and low body weight.
